Use tabs for indentation and spaces for alignment.

When rewriting or refactoring existing code, replace the old code with the new version.

When writing new functions, place them in order of first appearance in the file (or parent file for test cases).

Unless explicitly told otherwise, preserve comments when rewriting source material.

Use camelCase for variable names.

When writing constant numerals over 10000 in Golang, use underscores to separate every 3 orders of magnitude. Do not do this for any other language (nor for numerals under 10K).
